headline: Electric and Hybrid Vehicles Capture Three-Quarters of Europe's Auto Market
summary: Electric and hybrid vehicles accounted for around 75% of new vehicle registrations in Europe last month, as gasoline and diesel sales declined amid rising energy commodity prices.
why: Shifts in automotive market share reflect changing consumer demand, regulatory pressures, and sensitivity to energy and fuel costs.

impacts.name: European Automotive Sector
impacts.why: The sales shift directly alters the market composition for European auto manufacturers.
